Name: Experience Bars
Author: spacechase0
Description:
[b]Experience Bars[/b] adds experience bars for your skill levels, so you can see how far you are from leveling.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
Press [font=Courier New]X[/font] to toggle the display. Move the display with [font=Courier New]Shift[/font] + [font=Courier New]X[/font]. You can optionally [url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/tree/develop/ExperienceBars#configure]configure the mod[/url].

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.5+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

[b][size=5]See also[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/blob/develop/ExperienceBars/docs/release-notes.md#release-notes]Release notes[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods]Source code[/url]
[/list]
